200:
Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) A banana taped to a wall sells for $6.2 million at auction
B) A painting of a single dot sells for $90 million
C) An empty picture frame sells for $1 million at Christie's

A) A banana taped to a wall sells for $6.2 million at auction (November 2024)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) Taylor Swift fans shake the ground like a small earthquake at a Seattle concert
B) Taylor Swift's Eras Tour is banned in Norway for being too loud
C) A Taylor Swift concert causes a blackout across Brazil

A) Taylor Swift fans shake the ground like a small earthquake at a Seattle concert (July 2023)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) The British public votes to name a polar research ship 'Boaty McBoatface'
B) Australia names a navy submarine 'Subby McSubface'
C) NASA names a Mars rover 'Rovey McRoverface'

A) The British public votes to name a polar research ship 'Boaty McBoatface' (2016)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) Man throws away a hard drive holding thousands of bitcoins, later worth hundreds of millions
B) Man finds his lost Bitcoin password in his grandmother's cookbook
C) Bitcoin's creator Satoshi Nakamoto reveals himself on live TV

A) Man throws away a hard drive holding thousands of bitcoins, later worth hundreds of millions (Wales, 2013 onwards)
(others: B and C are made up)
300:
Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) A cat called Larry, Downing Street's 'Chief Mouser', outlasts five prime ministers
B) The White House makes a dog its official press secretary
C) The Kremlin gives a medal to a cat for catching a spy

A) A cat called Larry, Downing Street's 'Chief Mouser', outlasts five prime ministers (2011 to today)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) Burger King Japan launches a burger with a black bun and black cheese
B) McDonald's Japan sells a sushi burger in every branch
C) KFC Japan stops selling chicken at Christmas

A) Burger King Japan launches a burger with a black bun and black cheese (2014)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) Japanese train company apologises after a train leaves 20 seconds early
B) Tokyo bans talking on trains for a whole year
C) Japan fines commuters for running on station stairs

A) Japanese train company apologises after a train leaves 20 seconds early (November 2017)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) The Netherlands closes prisons because it doesn't have enough prisoners
B) Norway turns all its prisons into hotels
C) Sweden lets prisoners vote on their own sentences

A) The Netherlands closes prisons because it doesn't have enough prisoners (2010s)
(others: B and C are made up)
400:
Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) Rotterdam agrees to take apart a historic bridge so Jeff Bezos's superyacht can pass
B) Venice lets Jeff Bezos's superyacht dock in St Mark's Square
C) Monaco builds a new harbour just for Jeff Bezos's superyacht

A) Rotterdam agrees to take apart a historic bridge so Jeff Bezos's superyacht can pass (February 2022; the plan was later dropped)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) China and Nepal officially re-measure Mount Everest at 8,848.86 m
B) Mount Everest loses its 'highest' title after K2 is re-measured
C) Nepal puts a lift on the last 100 m of Everest

A) China and Nepal officially re-measure Mount Everest at 8,848.86 m (December 2020)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) Ronaldo moves two Coca-Cola bottles at a press conference and Coke's market value dips by about $4 billion
B) Messi drinks water on camera and Pepsi's shares jump 10%
C) Mbappé yawns at a press conference and Nike loses $1 billion

A) Ronaldo moves two Coca-Cola bottles at a press conference and Coke's market value dips by about $4 billion (Euro 2020, June 2021)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) Lego pieces from a 1997 cargo spill keep washing up on Cornish beaches decades later
B) A container of Nutella sinks and turns a Greek beach brown
C) Millions of rubber ducks wash up on the beach in Alexandria

A) Lego pieces from a 1997 cargo spill keep washing up on Cornish beaches decades later (Cornwall, England)
(others: B and C are made up)
500:
Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) Scientists say they've brought back the dire wolf, extinct for over 10,000 years
B) Scientists clone a woolly mammoth that now lives in a Siberian zoo
C) A living dodo is found on a remote Pacific island

A) Scientists say they've brought back the dire wolf, extinct for over 10,000 years (April 2025)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) A botched restoration of a Spanish church fresco, 'Ecce Homo', turns the town into a tourist hit
B) The Louvre lets a fan repaint the Mona Lisa's smile
C) The Vatican swaps the Sistine Chapel ceiling for a printed copy

A) A botched restoration of a Spanish church fresco, 'Ecce Homo', turns the town into a tourist hit (Borja, 2012)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) Prince Harry's memoir Spare becomes the fastest-selling non-fiction book ever
B) Prince William's cookbook outsells Harry Potter
C) King Charles's gardening book is banned in America

A) Prince Harry's memoir Spare becomes the fastest-selling non-fiction book ever (January 2023)
(others: B and C are made up)

Only one of these headlines is real. Which one?
A) A Spanish lottery winner gives the whole prize to his village bar
B) A six-year-old in Japan becomes the world's youngest bus driver
C) Almost every family in a Spanish village wins the Christmas lottery, except one man who didn't buy a ticket

C) Almost every family in a Spanish village wins the Christmas lottery, except one man who didn't buy a ticket (Sodeto, December 2011)
(others: A and B are made up)
